title: 'Mushoku Tensei III' Reveals Additional Cast, "Chaos Breaker" Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Rifujin na Magonote 's Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) light novel revealed additional cast and the "Chaos Breaker" promotional video for the third season on Monday. The anime premiered on July 6 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX and BS11, followed by KBS Kyoto, and Sun TV.

Cast Perugius Dola: Rikiya Koyama ( Fate/Zero ) Sylvaril: Ayumi Tsunematsu ( Awajima Hyakkei ) Atoferatofe Rybak: Nanako Mori ( Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED Freedom )

Ryousuke Shibuya ( Saikyou Onmyouji no Isekai Tenseiki ) is directing and handling the series composition for the third season at Studio Bind , with Naoto Taniuchi (Ruri no Houseki script) also handling the series composition. Sanae Shimada ( Photokano ) and Ryouta Furukawa ( Kaijuu 8-gou animation director) are designing the characters. Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( No Game No Life: Zero ) is composing the music.

Produced by Studio Bind, the 23-episode first season aired in split cours in Winter 2021 and Fall 2021 . The 24-episode second season premiered in two parts, with the first part in Summer 2023 and the second part in Spring 2024 . Funimation and Crunchyroll simulcast the anime series with English subtitles, respectively.

Rifujin na Magonote penned the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website between November 2012 and April 2015. Kadokawa began printing the novel with illustrations by Sirotaka under its MF Books label in January 2014 and released the 26th and final volume in November 2022.

Yuka Fujikawa began serializing a manga adaptation in Comic Flapper magazine in May 2014. Kadokawa published the 24th volume on February 24, with the 25th volume scheduled for a September 18 release.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed both the light novel and manga in English and published the 26th and final light novel volume in March 2024. The 23th manga volume went on sale on July 21, while the 24th volume will be released in March 2027.

PV (Chaos Breaker ver.)

title: Little Red Riding Hood Meets a Corpse on Her Journey TV Anime Announced for 2027
content:
Aito Aoyagi’s fairy tale mystery novel series Little Red Riding Hood Meets a Corpse on Her Journey ( Akazukin, Tabi no Tochu de Shitai to Deau. ) is getting a TV anime adaptation in 2027. A teaser visual and trailer were revealed, along with the first cast and staff.

Yume Miyamoto will voice Little Red Riding Hood, with Akira Sekine as Pinocchio. The teaser visual shows the English title Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story and features the two character. You can check it out below.

The series mxies familiar fairy tale settings with mystery storytelling. It follows the traveling Little Red Riding Hood as she encounters crimes and other mysteries throughout the fairy tale world and attempts to uncover the truth behind them. The teaser trailer shows her questioning a culprit’s poor criminal plan.

Studio BENTEN Film, which was recently acquired by AI animation company Creator’s X , is in charge of the animation. The main staff includes:

• Director/Script: Itsuro Kawasaki

• Character Design: Manami Minakata, Yuko Yahiro

• Art Director: Izumi Hoki, Hiroshi Kato

• Color Setting: Tomoe Yoshimura

• Composition Direction: Rieko Koike

• Editing: Daisuke Hiraki

• Animation Production: BENTEN Film

The franchise has also received a manga adaptation by Noka Tanaka and was previously adapted into a live-action Netflix film titled Once Upon a Crime .
author: Anime Corner

title: Novel 'Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau.' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Aito Aoyagi 's Akazukin, Tabi no Tochuu de Shitai to Deau. ( Little Red Riding Hood… ) novel on Monday, revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Voice actresses Yume Miyamoto ( Kanojo ga Koushaku-tei ni Itta Riyuu ) and Akira Sekine ( Tsue to Tsurugi no Wistoria ) are starring as Akazukin (Little Red Riding Hood) and Pinocchio, respectively.

Staff Director, Screenplay: Itsurou Kawasaki ( Oroka na Tenshi wa Akuma to Odoru ) Character Design: Manami Minakata ( Babanbabanban Vampire sub-character design), Yuuko Yahiro ( Aharen-san wa Hakarenai ) Art Director: Izumi Hoki ( Net-juu no Susume ), Hiroshi Katou ( Shinseiki Evangelion ) Color Design: Chie Yoshimura ( Reincarnation no Kaben ) Director of Photography: Rieko Koike ( Chanto Suenai Kyuuketsuki-chan ) Editing: Daisuke Hiraki ( Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru ) Studio: BENTEN Film

Aoyagi published the comedy mystery novel through Futabasha in August 2020. The fourth volume went on sale in July 2025.

Kanoka Tana drew a manga adaptation from January 2023 to May 2025. It was first serialized in Monthly Action magazine before being transferred to Web Action . The fourth and final volume was published by Futabasha in June 2025. The series has a cumulative 600,000 copies of its volumes in circulation.

Synopsis The fairytale of Little Red Riding Hood is as classic as they come, a familiar delivery of cookies and wine. But on this particular journey, Little Red Riding Hood…encounters a dead body?! As the mystery begins to unfold, familiar faces from other fairytales such as "Cinderella", "Hansel and Gretel", and "Sleeping Beauty" bring their own countless twists and tricks. Will she be able to solve the larger puzzle at the center of it all? A new detective is born!

title: Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Chaos Breaker Trailer Arc Trailer Revealed, Begins on August 16
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed a trailer for the Chaos Breaker arc, which will begin with Episode 8 on August 16. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .

The anime previously revealed character visuals for Rudy, Roxy, and Sylphiette as it entered the Rudeus Adolescence Arc . Episode 8 is titled “The Flying Fortress,” while you can watch the trailer for the new arc below.

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime's Video Unveils Cast, October 3 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga unveiled on Monday the anime's first promotional video, main visual, cast members, and October 3 premiere.

The anime will star:

Kengo Takanashi as Nemukunai (Insomniac), the eldest of the seven brothers

Makoto Tanikawa as Hakuai (Fraternity), the second of the seven brothers

Haruki Ishiya as Atsugariya (Feverish), the third of the seven brothers

Satoshi Inomata as Samugariya (Chilly), the fourth of the seven brothers

Kiyoto Mizuno as Kemono Tsukai (Beast-Tamer), the fifth of the seven brothers and one of the triplets

Taishi Murata as Tsurugi Jiman (Swordsman), the sixth of the seven brothers and one of the triplets

Reiji Kawashima as Harapeko (Hungry), the seventh of the brothers and one of the triplets

Akeno Watanabe as Baribara, the tenth general of the Marronnier kingdom and mother of the seven brothers

Show Hayami as Narrator

The anime will premeire on October 3 on the NHK Educational channel at 6:25 p.m. JST (5:25 a.m. EDT).

The fantasy romance manga centers on seven brothers who are knights of the Marronnier Kingdom. The kingdom lies in the center of a group of eight kingdoms, and each brother is dispatched to a different kingdom as ambassadors, to go on an adventure to find their fated partner. The brothers are named: Nemukunai (Not Sleepy), Hakuai (Benevolent), Atsugariya (Sensitive to Heat), Samugariya (Sensitive to Cold), Kemono Tsukai (Beast Tamer), Tsurugi Jiman (Sword Pride), and Harapeko (Hungry).

Kiyoko Sayama ( Skip Beat! , Vampire Knight , To Your Eternity seasons 2-3) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Shinzō Fujita ( To Your Eternity seasons 1-3, The World Is Still Beautiful ) is both writing and overseeing the series scripts. Yuriko Maeda (chief animation director for Requiem of the Rose King , One Punch Man TV 2 ) is designing the characters, Yoshiaki Fujisawa ( Apocalypse Hotel , Land of the Lustrous , Love Live! School idol project ) is composing the music, and Jin Aketagawa ( Dr. Stone , Fire Force ) is the sound director.

The manga launched in Shogakukan 's Flowers magazine in 2016. Shogakukan shipped the 11th volume on June 10. The manga topped the list of manga for female readers in the 2018 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

Iwamoto's Kingdom of Gold, Kingdom of Water manga inspired the Gold Kingdom and Water Kingdom anime film that opened in January 2023. Seven Seas Entertainment released the original manga in English.
author: ANN

title: Shiori Teshirogi Launches Manga Miniseries in September
content:
The September issue of Akita Shoten 's Mystery Bonita magazine announced on August 6 that manga creator Shiori Teshirogi and her younger brother and novelist Shōtarō Teshirogi will launch a four-chapter manga miniseries titled Fushigiri Muichi (Muichi the Slayer of Immortals) in the magazine's next issue on September 4. Shiori Teshirogi is drawing the art, and Shōtarō Teshirogi is writing the story.

The manga is set during the early Meiji Period, and centers on the titular Tamahashi Muichi, once a secret lawman of the late Shogunate government, and who has now traded his sword for a painter's brush. That is, until he receives word of the activities of the Restoration agitator Sakamoto Ryōma, who is supposed to be dead.

The Teshirogi siblings previously published a two-chapter manga with the same title and story in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine in October 2021.

Shiori Teshirogi launched the Batman and the Justice League manga in Akita Shoten 's Champion RED magazine in June 2017, and ended it in May 2019. Akita Shoten published four compiled book volumes for the manga. Teshirogi also published the "Justice League Origin: Wonder Woman" one-shot manga in July 2017.

Teshirogi's Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas - Meiō Shinwa manga ran from 2006 to 2011, and inspired two OVA series that totaled 26 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series, and Discotek released the series on DVD in November 2015. Teshirogi launched the Saint Seiya: The Lost Canvas - Meiō Shinwa Gaiden manga in 2011, and ended it in April 2016.

Shōtarō Teshirogi wrote the Kou-Tetsujo Iron Castle novel, the second part an original manga and novel project in collaboration with Anima , with designs by Yasuo Ohtagaki ( Mobile Suit Gundam Thunderbolt , Moonlight Mile ). The novel shipped in March 2021.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Blue Lock Film Confirms 3 More Cast Members
content:
The staff for the live-action film based on Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's BLUE LOCK soccer manga confirmed three more cast members on Monday. The film's staff also announced that the film will screen in MX4D, 4DX, and Dolby Cinema starting on August 21. Additionally, cheering screenings (in which audiences are allowed to shout at and interact with the film) will be held at five participating theaters in Hokkaido, Tokyo, Aichi, Osaka, and Fukuoka.

The newly announced cast members are:

FANTASTICS member Yūsei Yagi as Rin Itoshi

Keisuke Watanabe as Jyubei Aryu

Omi Natsuki as Aoshi Tokimitsu

The cast includes:

• Fumiya Takahashi as Yoichi Isagi

• Kaito Sakurai as Meguru Bachira

• Kyōhei Takahashi as Hyoma Chigiri

• Kōta Nomura as Rensuke Kunigami

• Yuzu Aoki as Gurimu Igarashi

• Shō Nishigaki as Asahi Naruhaya

• Yūki Tachibana as Gin Gagamaru

• Raizō Ishikawa as Jingo Raichi

• Joey Iwanaga as Okuhito Iemon

• Shunya Asano as Wataru Kuon

• Yūki Sakurai as Yudai Imamura

• Yūki Kura as Ryosuke Kira

• Masataka Kubota as Jinpachi Ego

• Kōhei Higuchi as Zantetsu Tsurugi

• idol group TEAM's K as Seishiro Nagi

• Keito Tsuna as Reo Mikage

• Mei Hata as Anri Teieri

• Sōshō Tomimoto as Team Y's Ikki Niko

• Keisuke Kida as Team Y's Hibiki О̄kawa

• Keisuke Higashi as Team X's Shōei Barō

• Ryōta Miura as the twins Junichi Wanima and Keisuke Wanima

• Shihō Harumi as Hirotoshi Buratsuta, the chair of the Japan Football Union

• Sōma Santoki as Tomonari Tada, Isagi's teammate

• Yūsuke Hirayama as Isshin Tomobe, Isagi's coach

• Tōru Nomaguchi as Issei Isagi, Isagi's father

• Maho Nonami as Iyo Isagi, Isagi's mother

Yūsuke Taki is directing the film, and Tetsuo Kamata is writing the screenplay. Shinzō Matsuhashi is serving as a producer. CREDEUS (live-action Golden Kamuy film) is producing the film, and TOHO is distributing.

The film opened in Japan on August 7.

Kaneshiro and Nomura launched the manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in August 2018. Kodansha will publish the manga's 40th compiled book volume on August 17. The manga won the Best Shōnen Manga award in Kodansha 's 45th annual Manga Awards in 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English digitally and is also releasing it in print.

The original manga inspired a television anime series that premiered in Japan in October 2022 on TV Asahi and its affiliates in the NUMAnimation programming block. The anime ran for 24 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired, and is also streaming an English dub .

BLUE LOCK vs. U-20 JAPAN , the second television anime season, debuted in October 2024, and aired for 14 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, and CIS.

The anime is getting a third season, adapting the "Shin Eiyū Taisen" (New Hero Wars) story.

Kōta Sannomiya 's BLUELOCK -Episode Nagi- manga spinoff focuses on Seishirō Nagi before he enters the titular BLUE LOCK facility. The manga launched in June 2022 in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine and ended in July 2025. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the spinoff manga in print.

The spinoff inspired an anime film that premiered in Japan in April 2024. The film sold 337,000 tickets to earn 463 million yen (about US$2.99 million) in its first three days, and ranked at #2 in the Japanese box office in its opening weekend. The film opened in North America in June 2024. Crunchyroll is streaming the film with subtitles and with several dubs.
author: ANN

title: Cat Companions Maruru and Hachi Manga Returns From Hiatus
content:
Sonoda put the manga on hiatus in January 2025 due to health reasons.

Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

An odd couple of stray cats team up to share the trials and tribulations of life in this heartwarming manga. Maruru lived a pampered life till one day, he ran after a flock of sparrows and couldn't find his way back home. He encounters Hachi, a tough stray, who says he doesn't need a spoiled house cat on his territory and chases him away. But then Maruru helps Hachi out of a jam, and they team up to face life on the street together.

Sonoda launched the manga on Kodansha 's Comic Days website in December 2021, and Kodansha published its sixth volume in December 2024. Seven Seas Entertainment published the sixth volume in English on April 28.

The manga won the grand prize in the Comic division of the 54th Japan Cartoonists Association Awards last year.
author: ANN
